The Metropolitan Transportation Authority is hiring an Associate Infrastructure Engineer to support and maintain IT infrastructure and systems. The role monitors system availability, scalability, and performance, supports network infrastructure, and collaborates with IT teams on projects.
Transportation/Trucking/Railroad
Responsibilities
Repairs, maintains, and provides preventative maintenance for an area of the infrastructure to ensure systems availability targets are met
Implements changes to one or more components of the infrastructure, executing tests and reporting on performance, to meet requested needs
Troubleshoots hardware and software problems by analyzing a chain of events and applying technical knowledge following established procedures and standards to resolve immediate customer needs
Maintains and updates existing documentation and standard operating procedures to ensure accurate and timely information is available for assigned systems
Works with more experienced colleagues and other IT technical resources to improve coordination of infrastructure requirements and analyze issues as they arise
Participates in the evaluation of new products and technologies, under the direction and guidance of senior colleagues, relevant to assigned infrastructure area to enhance technology engineering service value
Performs capacity planning exercises to properly identify required hardware, software, configuration/architecture necessary to support application needs
Monitors and reports tech infrastructure usage trends
Assists with installation, configuration, and maintenance of physical IT hardware infrastructure components of systems, servers, cloud, storage, routers, switches, firewalls, data centers, and workstations
Assists with the technical security of the IT infrastructure by setting up firewalls, managing access controls/operating systems/ database servers, configuring VPNs, and taking proactive measures against potential cyber threats. Follows security protocols and complies with security standards, and handles security incidents
Assists with installation and configuration of software applications, operating systems, databases, and utilities according to organizational requirements. Conducts regular monitoring of software components and tunes them for optimal performance. Identifies performance issues within the software environment, escalating as appropriate
Assists with the implementation of local and wide-area networks (LAN and WAN), configures routers and switches, and determines proper implementation of network cable and hardware requirements
Travel may be required to other MTA locations or other external sites
May need to work outside of normal work hours supporting 24/7 operations (i.e., evenings and weekends)
Performs other duties and tasks as assigned
Observing the work performed by the contractor
Reviewing invoices and approving them if the work meets contractual standards
Addressing performance issues with the contractor when possible
Escalating issues to other parties as needed
Regular and reliable attendance is expected and required
Qualification
IT Security
Network Security
Network Routing
Server Administration
Disaster Recovery
Systems Monitoring
Operating System Installation
Patch Management
Storage Capacity Planning
Data Migration
Hardware and Software Troubleshooting
User Access Management
Required
bachelor's degree and minimum of 1 year of relevant experience. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered in lieu of a degree
1 year
Fundamental awareness in analyzing storage needs, such as interpreting metrics and analyzing capacity trends
Fundamental awareness of Disaster Recovery principles and tools, including types of disasters, basic recovery strategies, and the importance of data backup and protection
Fundamental awareness in conducting routine server maintenance and troubleshooting common issues
Fundamental awareness of patch deployment and ensuring systems are up-to-date and secure
Fundamental awareness in configuring software and hardware and executing predefined scripts
Fundamental awareness in migrating systems and data with minimal downtime and data integrity
Fundamental awareness in installing and upgrading operating systems with guidance
Fundamental awareness in monitoring systems for assessing performance and diagnosing issues
Fundamental awareness in system administration tasks, including managing user permissions, maintaining system efficiency, and ensuring uptime
Fundamental awareness of defining resource needs for projects and operational tasks
Fundamental awareness of the hardware lifecycle, including installation, upgrades, and maintenance
Fundamental awareness of IT security principles, able to implement robust security measures under guidance and respond to incidents with due diligence
Fundamental awareness of network security (e.g., firewalls, network ports, etc.) and connecting enterprise networks to the cloud
Fundamental awareness of various hardware components, networking devices, servers, backup systems, and cabling.  Intermediate understanding of computing systems and ability to troubleshoot complex hardware/software issues
Fundamental awareness of various software components, firmware, operating systems, database servers, and operations software (monitoring, backup, routing, job scheduling, etc.)
Basic skills in network routing configuration and troubleshooting
Fundamental awareness of current system usage trends and ability to forecast future needs
Fundamental awareness of IT domains
Capable of active listening, attention to detail, customer service, prioritization, and problem-solving skills
Works independently and strategically
Capable of identifying and analyzing risks and developing effective mitigation strategies
Basic skill set to understand various technologies, systems, and potential risks
Capable of critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
Capable of interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with both technical and non-technical peers
Capable of assisting multiple projects simultaneously and prioritizing tasks based on urgency and impact
Fundamental awareness and hands-on experience with related tools
Capable of working under pressure and meeting deadlines individually and collaboratively. Thinks logically, assesses problems, and is results-oriented
Capable of identifying business and technology risks and associated vulnerabilities
Capable of communicating effectively, both orally and in writing, to interact with team members, customers, management, and support personnel (technical and non-technical)
Adept in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with employees at all levels within the organization, and with both internal and external customers
Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives
Creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful
Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences
Anticipating and adopting innovations in business-building digital  and technology applications
Specialized knowledge and expertise on tools, programs, domains, platforms, and products used for specific tasks
Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization
Benefits
This position is eligible for teleworking, which is currently 2 days per week. New hires are eligible to apply 30 days after their effective date of hire.
